whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Jagat's Martial Arts Academy,

I noticed your academy has exceptional 4.9★ reviews in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and batch inquiries.

Maine aapke martial arts academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, self-defense & karate training programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/jagatsma

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Jagat's Martial Arts Academy team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and a showcase of your top-rated karate and self-defense training in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings aur actual student photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
